Prices

Questions

How much do projects in websites and web platforms cost?
An MVP in this group costs $1,000–60,000 (UZS 12–725 mln), a full version up to $180,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 1–18 weeks, a full version 3–44 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Domain and hosting access; Texts, photos and the logo; One person who makes the decisions.
